summary: Megan Holdings Ltd. filed Form 6-K containing its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Proxy Statement for a meeting on July 13, 2026. The principal proposals are a share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares at a ratio up to 1-for-400, authorized by the board to be implemented within two years, and amendments to the memorandum and articles to reduce notice periods from 10 to 5 clear days for meetings and from 5 to 2 calendar days for service by post. This is a routine governance filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms or strategic corporate action are present.
